definitions.explanation: To put on clothing worn on the upper body or full body (shirts, jackets, dresses). Different verbs are used for lower body, head, and accessories.

examples.japanese: {今日|きょう}は{何|なに}を{着|き}ますか？
コートを{着|き}てください。
{彼女|かのじょ}は{赤|あか}いドレスを{着|き}ています。
examples.english: She is wearing a red dress.

notes: An ichidan verb for upper body/full body clothing. Opposite: {脱|ぬ}ぐ (nugu, to take off). Different verbs for different items: はく (pants/shoes), かぶる (hats), する (accessories). Don't confuse with {切|き}る (kiru, to cut - godan).
